name: appsotech
description: Appsotech Limited skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: Audit and assessment skills for codebases and running systems, starting with the 13-Layer App Audit: weighted score, hard-gate verdict, findings register, remediation plan

plugins.name: build
plugins.description: Scaffold applications on the Appsotech house stack: Go APIs (fasthttp, pgx/v5), Next.js and React/Vite surfaces, Flutter mobile, PostgreSQL with RLS, Redis, R2 and Coolify deployment, to a fixed layout with allocated ports and databases. Delegates design and UI work to the design plugin

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design and build user interfaces against a frozen, accessibility-gated design system — style direction, palette, font pairing, design tokens, light and dark mode, responsive layout, motion, hero treatments, eight page archetypes, and a mechanical gate that checks the result in a real browser. Stack-agnostic: React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Flutter, plain HTML or a single file
